metadata.notes: Task registry â€” what the model is for. A task = prediction target + head shape + compatible label strategies. The Train UI's second picker selects from this list, filtered by the chosen algorithm's `supports` field.

direction_classifier.name: Direction Classifier
direction_classifier.head: binary
direction_classifier.description: Predict direction at horizon (next bar close, or first hit of profit/stop/time barriers). Output: P(up). Works with any algorithm that supports `classification`.

range_classifier.name: Range-Bucket Classifier
range_classifier.head: k-class
range_classifier.description: Quantize next-N-bar high-low range into K buckets. Output: P(bucket_k). Headline metric: within-2-point accuracy.

multi_head.name: Multi-Head (Direction + Magnitude + Confidence)
multi_head.head: multi
multi_head.description: Joint output heads: direction (binary), magnitude (regression), confidence (Bernoulli). Requires an algorithm flagged `supports: multi-head`.

online_direction_skill.name: Online Direction (skill vs majority)
online_direction_skill.head: regression
online_direction_skill.description: Forecast the H-bar forward log return from a streaming learner, scored PREQUENTIALLY (every bar is scored before it is trained on, so the metric is out-of-sample by construction). Headline is SKILL = hit rate minus the RUNNING MAJORITY CLASS -- never raw accuracy, because MNQ's up-rate is 0.4811 at H=1 and 0.5566 at H=1440, so the majority flips sides with the horizon and a fixed 0.50 baseline flatters the model.

walk_forward_cycle.name: Walk-forward cycle
walk_forward_cycle.head: binary
walk_forward_cycle.description: Load bars, optionally tune, then per walk-forward fold: train, validate, and walk the test bars one at a time predicting P(up), trading them with the MNQ cost model and updating running metrics. Streams every step live and lands predictions, trades, folds and epochs in data/models/<model_id>/.

ticks_per_day_goal.name: Net ticks per session day vs a daily goal
ticks_per_day_goal.head: binary
ticks_per_day_goal.description: Predict whether the open H bars after the fill exceeds the fill (the next open), trade the signal through the Model Cycle simulator with costs and roll charges, and score every configuration of a round in net ticks per CME session day against a goal (600 MNQ ticks). Rounds are defined in src/config/ta_strategy_rounds.json; every table lands in derived_ta_strategy_600_ticks_*.

bracket_meta_label.name: Bracket meta-label (2:1 / 3:1, trade every session)
bracket_meta_label.head: multi_binary
bracket_meta_label.description: For every 5-minute RTH decision bar and each bracket (long/short x 2:1/3:1, stop = 1x ATR, target sized so the net win is R x the net loss after AMP costs), predict P(net win). A policy trades every session, one position at a time. Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-29-multimodal/PLAN.md.
